the surgical unit here to have fluid drained from a finger joint. I expected a doctor's surgery type environment...which I presume are in the same building. In complete contrast the surgical unit is exactly what you would expect in a major hospital, but in miniature. Went in, the front door/reception, 10 minutes before my appointment time. I kid you not, this was the typical wait at any doctor's reception. Wasn't long at all but got me closer to my appointment time that I would have liked. Nothing to do with the staff, they were great and efficient, just the fact there were people with more complex needs before me. Fro registering I was there and walking to the unit I needed was not any amount of time worth mentioning. But before I got my bum in a seat the surgical team called me through. From there into a consultation room for a chat about my lumpy finger joint. Within ten minutes they explained what they thought was the issue and how they would like to do with regards treatment. Now this for me is where it gets interesting. Walked out of the cunsult into a hospital like pre surgery prep. The full nine yards. Scrubs, feet covers, iodine meticulously applied. Splash guard  put over me and the team looked like they were prepped for an ER. Numbed with the usual....sliced and diced, cleaned wrapped and out with aftercare advice. Total time from getting out of the car, to getting back in the car.....I kid you not....twenty minutes. Absolutely amazing team work. Great, direct, communication. They explained what it was, what was going to happen and aftercare in a manner I found comfortable and yet precise and very professional.

5 stars doesn't seem enough.

And the incision scaring....is so small and neat. I've had grazes bigger.",null,[0,238]]]],[null,null,null,null,null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/949496955442225658/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjVHV21Rd2NGZFJiRXBZVjJ0c01GbDZRazlSV0ZKcFZXcEtUbVZYWXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/949496955442225658/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjVHV21Rd2NGZFJiRXBZVjJ0c01GbDZRazlSV0ZKcFZXcEtUbVZYWXhBQhAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/949496955442225658/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjVHV21Rd2NGZFJiRXBZVjJ0c01GbDZRazlSV0ZKcFZXcEtUbVZYWXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/949496955442225658/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjVHV21Rd2NGZFJiRXBZVjJ0c01GbDZRazlSV0ZKcFZXcEtUbVZYWXhBQhAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/949496955442225658/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjVHV21Rd2NGZFJiRXBZVjJ0c01GbDZRazlSV0ZKcFZXcEtUbVZYWXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/949496955442225658/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjVHV21Rd2NGZFJiRXBZVjJ0c01GbDZRazlSV0ZKcFZXcEtUbVZYWXhBQhAA"]],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25GWmQwcFdRbEpYV2tsMFl6Qk9RWFJpVWpKTmVXYxAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x4e8fcd3b47d5ce44!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOnFZd0pWQlJXWkl0YzBOQXRiUjJNeWc%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25GWmQwcFdRbEpYV2tsMFl6Qk9RWFJpVWpKTmVXYxAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjXvpaFhLSTAxV9RoQGHd8KM_oQoykIDCgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwjXvpaFhLSTAxV9RoQGHd8KM_oQ0pMFCAooAg"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBeHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMUF5V1ZJM1psOWZSV2hCWTFGRFZFSnlWMDVNUW1sdlFWOUZWVUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpSUVVOWlgxcG9TSFE0V1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tobmQwa3hXRzFVZERodmVDMXVUbWxtZUZaRGNtYxAB",["0x0:0x4e8fcd3b47d5ce44",null,1769155178908335,1769155178908335,[null,null,["https://www.google
